description: The minutes of one finished SPX session that the tape itself marked as market-moving, with what stood beside each: the scheduled event that owned the minute, the moment two or more public news desks carried an item (timed to the second, labelled by class, never the headline's text), or the honest reading that no headline existed and the dealer book moved on its own. Each minute carries the index move over the next 5 and 15 minutes and the flip at that minute. Use when: 'what moved SPX at 14:25 on 2026-09-10', 'were there news-driven minutes yesterday', 'which afternoon moves had no headline'. Not for: the scheduled calendar itself (get_events) or the day's levels (get_levels). Limits: finished sessions only (the live day is part of the paid live stream), sessions from 2022-04 on, ET clock.

day.description: The session, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the last finished session)

tape_only.description: Only minutes the tape confirmed (default true; false adds the flashes the tape ignored and the calendar events it did not react to)

name: get_market_moving_minutes

data_as_of.description: The time this answer's data is true as of, ISO 8601 with the ET offset: a finished session's close (13:00 on an early close), the minute a ladder was read at, or the source's own build stamp. Null when the source states none.

minutes.description: The marked minutes of the session in clock order

desks.description: How many public desks carried an item inside three minutes (flash rows)

flash_at.description: HH:MM:SS ET of the first desk's item (flash rows)

flip.description: The zero-gamma flip at the minute

kind.description: calendar (a scheduled event owned the minute), flash (public news desks carried an item beside it), or book (no headline: the dealer book moved on its own)

label.description: FirmTape's own label: the event's name, a headline class, or 'no headline, the book did this'. Never a headline's text.

move_15.description: Index points from the minute before to fifteen minutes on

move_5.description: Index points from the minute before to five minutes on

tag.description: geopolitics, macro, central_bank, energy, rates, stock, clock or other

tape_confirmed.description: True when the tape itself moved at the minute (a one-minute index move of 4 sigma of the trailing half hour, or 3 sigma with the book moving too)

url.description: The first official article on the item, from the publisher's own feed (flash rows, when matched)

usually.description: What usually followed this class of minute across every session measured: count, median 15-minute move, share that continued the 5-minute move

z.description: The one-minute spot move in sigmas of the trailing half hour

server_version.description: Version of the FirmTape MCP server that produced this answer

summary.description: One sentence carrying this answer's numbers, its trading day and its source, written to be quoted verbatim to a reader rather than paraphrased.

title: Minutes that moved the tape
